intent: The Brother status report stops lying while a job is stuck: it names the real reason the USB probe was skipped, installs pyusb on its own, and flags a stalled job (paper misfeed) or a hung backend left behind by a cancelled job.
scope: Non-goal: fixing the printer's paper pick-up, which is mechanical
changes: USBResult.probe_note carries _usb_probe_skip_reason(): CUPS busy / pyusb missing / printer silent; display prints it instead of 'pyusb not available'
run.sh ensure_pyusb: probes /usr/bin/python3 (what sudo runs; the user's python3 is a pyenv shim) and pacman-installs python-pyusb
_stuck_job.py: scans /proc for usb://Brother backends; orphaned backend of a cancelled job -> cups:backend-orphaned + y/N SIGKILL offer; job-impressions-completed frozen 15 s -> cups:job-stalled
41xxx status now reads 'Out of Paper / not feeding' since a misfeed sets the same paper-empty bit

verification.evidence: Note: USB status probe skipped: CUPS has a job on the printer; status obtained via CUPS only.

verification.command: fake orphan (exec -a usb://Brother/... sleep 40) + display_usb_results with stdin y
verification.evidence: Queue blocked by a hung backend of a cancelled job / Kill hung backend PID 960784 ... Backend killed; process gone

verification.command: flag_stuck_job with frozen vs moving counter
verification.evidence: frozen: cups:job-stalled after 15.0s; moving: cleared after 1.0s

verification.command: lpr Krasnale-sie-rzadza.pdf (jobs 106, 107 pages 52-55), monitored via ipptool
verification.evidence: all 55 pages on paper, user-confirmed; printer back at 10001 Ready

risks: Stall window is 15 s: a healthy run froze the counter up to ~9 s, so a very slow first page could false-flag
A status run during printing now blocks up to 15 s while it samples progress
rollback: Run ./run.sh on an idle printer and confirm Ready 10001
